messages.subject: Error changing instance type to xlarge
parts:
I'm using the free version of shinyapps and can't change the instance type to xlarge. In the dashboard, it will let me select the xlarge instance, but when I attempt to save the settings a small red error message in the lower right hand corner says "Error saving settings".

Are these instances not part of the free tier or is there something else wrong?
